z-m-30-01.title: Yintoni elandela i-1, 2, 4?
z-m-30-01.topic: Amandla ematrix: zingaphi iixabiso ezifunekayo ukugqiba ipatheni?
z-m-30-01.goal: Qonda ukuba kumandla ematrix, imithetho emininzi inokuhambelana namaxabiso ambalwa, hluza imithetho engumgqatswa uhlaziye isigwebo sakho njengoko uhamba, uze uchaze ukuba unokuqiniseka kwifomula ngokubanzi emva kokufumana isizathu (isakhiwo).
z-m-30-01.material: B yimatrix ye-2×2, kwaye iindawo zayo ezine (umqolo 1 ikholam 1, umqolo 1 ikholam 2, umqolo 2 ikholam 1, umqolo 2 ikholam 2) zonke zi-1. I-B^n yimatrix oyifumana ngokuphindaphinda i-B amaxesha angama-n. Zonke iindawo zinamanani okwenyani kwaye n yi-integer eyi-1 okanye ngaphezulu. Abahlobo ababini bathetha ngeendawo ze-B³. Omnye uthi, "Iindawo ze-B¹ ne-B² zi-1 no-2, ngoko i-B³ yi-3," kwaye omnye uthi, "Andikwazi ukuqiniseka okwangoku. Masiphindaphinde ngakumbi." Ngalo lonke ixesha idatha ivezwa, hlaziya isigwebo sakho okanye ugcine.
z-m-30-01.thinking.0: Xa wenza umthetho ngokubanzi ngedatha encinci, cinga nangeminye imithetho enokwenzeka
z-m-30-01.thinking.1: Ukulungisa isigwebo nenqanaba lokuzithemba ngokolwazi olutsha
z-m-30-01.thinking.2: Ukufumana umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo nokuchaza unobangela
z-m-30-01.thinking.3: Ukwenza ifomula ngokubanzi usebenzisa oonobumba (p, n) nokubhala isizathu
z-m-30-01.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda iimatrix ze-2×2 (indawo enye yemveliso = isixa semveliso yeendawo zomqolo omnye wematrix yangaphambili nekholam enye yematrix yangasemva) namandla A^n = A iphindaphindwe amaxesha angama-n
z-m-30-01.prereq.1: Ukufunda iintetho eziqulathe oonobumba n no-p nokufumana iipatheni zamanani alula
z-m-30-01.prereq.2: Ingcamango yolandelelwano lwesikolo: i-H2 yalo msebenzi yileyibhile yobunzima kwimveliso kuphela kwaye ayithethi ukuba i-Ministry of Education ibela oku kwibanga elithile. Sithatha ukuba ifika kwangoko emva kokufunda ukuphindaphinda iimatrix, kwaye ukungenisa okanye ii-determinant azifuneki.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Idatha iyavezwa inyathelo linye ngexesha. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha isigwebo sakho sangoku malunga neendawo zamandla e-B ziya kuba yintoni.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala yonke imithetho ehambelana namanani ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, uze uthelekise leyo ephelisiwe lulwazi olutsha.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba ukhethe ngokucinga ngomthetho omnye kuphela, okanye ucinge nangeminye imithetho.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.info: I-B¹ yi-B ngokwayo, ngoko zonke iindawo ezine zi-1. Xa i-B² yaphindaphindwa ngqo, zonke iindawo ezine zazi-2.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Zinjani iindawo ze-B³? Khetha isigwebo sakho sangoku.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Iinxalenye ezimbini zedatha zichaza zombini u-3 no-4. Unokuthatha umthetho omnye njenge 'ngcamango yokusebenza,' kodwa phambi kokujonga kunengqiqo ukugcina isigwebo sakho sivulekile.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zonke iindawo zi-3. Emva kwe-1, 2, umthetho wokonyuka nge-1 uyaqhubeka
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Zikho imithetho ehambelana ne-1, 2 ngaphandle kwe 'onyuka nge-1.' Ngamanqaku edatha amabini kuphela, kusenyanga ukuzinza kumthetho omnye.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zonke iindawo zi-4. Emva kwe-1, 2, umthetho wokuphindwa kabini uyaqhubeka
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umthetho wokuphindaphinda kabini nawo uhambelana ne-1, 2, kodwa kwanjalo 'yonyuka nge-1.' Qaphela ukuba kusekude ukukhetha omnye uze uqiniseke.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Asikwazi ukukhetha phakathi kwe-3 ne-4 okwangoku, ngoko hlola ngokuphindaphinda ngqo i-B³
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ubone ukuba amanqaku adatha amabini ahambelana nemithetho emininzi waza walibazisa isigwebo sakho. Ucinge nangesenzo sokuhlola (ukuphindaphinda ngqo).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Onke amangeniso angu-2. Yimatriksi enamangeniso onke afanayo, ngoko ixabiso alisatshintshi
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kwi-B², ixabiso selivele latshintsha ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-2. Ukuba amangeniso ayafana akuthethi ukuba ixabiso alitshintshi.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Xa i-B³ yaphindaphindwa ngqo, onke amangeniso amane ayi-4. Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku yi-1, 2, 4. Umthetho ohambelana nala manani awukho 'ukuphindaphinda kabini' kuphela. Ukudibanisa amaxabiso amabini angaphambili uze wongeze u-1 kunika i-1, 2, 4, 7, ..., kwaye oku kuhambelana nako.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngenxa ye-B³, 'yonyuka nge-1' ikhutshiwe. Kodwa umthetho wokuphindaphinda kabini nomthetho we-1, 2, 4, 7 awunakwahlulwa de i-B⁴ ibalwe. Kufuneka uqokelele idatha engakumbi okanye ufumane isizathu.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Misela umthetho wokuphindaphinda kabini uze ubhale ukuba onke amangeniso e-B⁴ ayi-8
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kuyinyani ukuba amaxabiso amathathu ahambelana nokuphindaphinda kabini, kodwa umthetho we-1, 2, 4, 7 uhambelana nawo nawo. Awukawahluli omabini.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lithathe u-4 we-B³ njengempazamo yokubala ugcine umthetho wokuqala wokuba onke ngama-3
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuba ugxeka ixabiso elibaliswe ngqo ngempazamo, unokugcina isigwebo sakho sokuqala kodwa awunasiseko. Ukuphinda uhlole ukubala kwahlukile ekulilahleni.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zikho imithetho emininzi, ngoko ungaqikeleli nakancinci ngale datha
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Yonyuka nge-1' ayisahambelani. Ukuba imithetho esalayo ixhitshiwe ngamanani nalo lulwazi.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Lahla 'yonyuka nge-1,' uze uhlele imithetho emibini esalayo nge-B⁴
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ulahlile umthetho ongahambelani nedatha waza wacinga nangendlela yokwahlula imithetho esalayo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Ndikhangele isizathu. Masithi onke amangeniso amane e-B^n ayinani elifanayo k. Ingeniso enye ye-B^(n+1) = B^n × B yi-(k × 1) + (k × 1) = 2k. Kuyimbalo efanayo kuwo onke amangeniso amane. Onke amangeniso e-B¹ ayi-1.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngoku ugweba njani amangeniso e-B^n ne-B⁵?
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Imilo apho onke amangeniso efana igcinwa ixesha ngalinye kwaye ixabiso liphindaphindwa kabini, ngoko amangeniso e-B^n ayi-2^(n−1). Isigwebo esashiywa sivulekile ekuqaleni njenge-'ingaba ngu-3 okanye u-4' sancipha ngolandelelwano lwedatha → imithetho ekhetheka → isizathu. Umfundi obale i-B⁴ ngqo ufikelela kwisigqibo esifanayo.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Amangeniso e-B^n onke ayi-n, kwaye ale-B⁵ onke ayi-5
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Umthetho we-n sele waphosakala kwi-B³. Awuhambelani nolwazi olutsha nawo (2k ixesha ngalinye siphindaphinda).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Amangeniso e-B^n onke ayi-2^(n−1), kwaye ale-B⁵ onke ayi-16
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Udibanise yonke indlela ukuya kwisizathu sokuba 'ukuphindaphinda ngalinye kunika i-2k' kusebenza kuyo yonke n.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kusenokwenzeka ukuba yi-2^(n−1), kodwa andiyi kuqiniseka phambi kokuphindaphinda i-B⁵ ngqo
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Isimo sengqondo sokufuna ukuhlola silungile. Kodwa ulwazi olutsha sisizathu esisebenza kuyo nayiphi na n. Cinga ukuba eso sizathu siyichaphazela njani ukuzithemba kwakho.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: I-B⁴ yi-7, ngoko i-B⁵ ngamanani onke ayi-12
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ugcine umthetho we-1, 2, 4, 7. Hlola ukuba uhambelana nolwazi olutsha lokuba k iba yi-2k.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.reflect: Ukusuka ekulibazisweni kwesigwebo ekuqaleni ukuya ekuzitheni ekugqibeleni, yintoni etshintshe ukuzithemba kwakho? Ukuqokelela amanqaku amathathu edatha engakumbi nokufumana 'isizathu' kwenza umahluko muni ekuzitheni kwakho?
z-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: U-Hayun, osebenza naye eklasini, wafumana amangeniso amandla e-C = 3B (imatriksi enamangeniso onke amane angama-3) njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi. Khetha umgca wokuqala owahamba kakubi.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha elinye kumangeniso e-C uze ubale ngqo ingeniso (umqolo 1, ikholamu 1) ye-C iphindaphindwe kabini ngokwayo.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa ixabiso elibaliswe ngqo nexabiso kumgca ngamnye uze ufumane umgca wokuqala apho ahluka khona.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.1: Onke amangeniso e-B² ayi-2, ngoko onke amangeniso e-C² ayi-3 × 2 = 6.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.2: Ngendlela efanayo C³ = 3B³, kwaye onke amangeniso e-B³ ayi-4, ngoko onke amangeniso e-C³ ayi-3 × 4 = 12.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.explain: Kumgca 1, ikhonstanti 3 ikhona kanye kwiinto ezimbini nganye, kodwa yakhutshwa kanye kuphela. Kwi-(3B)(3B) u-3 uvela kabini, ngoko C² = 9B², kwaye onke amangeniso ayi-9 × 2 = 18. Ukuba uyisikwere i-C ngqo ubale ingeniso enye kuphela, 3×3 + 3×3 = 18, ngoko ungaqinisekisa ukuba ayahluka kwi-6. Imigca 2 ukuya kwi-4 yazuza intetho yomgca 1 kwaye ayichanekanga. Umgca 3 nawo, ngesizathu esifanayo: C³ = 27B³ kwaye amangeniso ayi-108.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.prompt: Ngeli xesha, cinga ngematriksi P enamangeniso onke amane ayi-p (p linani eliphelele eliyongezelelo). Veza amangeniso e-P^n, P iphindaphindwe n amaxesha, ngo-p no-n, uze ubhale ukuba kutheni unokuthi njalo.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kwi-p=1 nakwi-p=2, phindaphinda i-P² ngqo uze uthelekise amangeniso.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala njengentetho ukuba amangeniso e-P² adityaniswe njani namangeniso e-P no-p, uze uhlole ukuba into efanayo yenzeka kwi-P³.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ingeniso 2^(n−1) ye-B^n iphinda iphuma kwintetho yam xa p=1?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndihlolile ukuba ihambelana namaxabiso aphindaphindwe ngqo ngokufaka n=1 no-n=2?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ndibhale ulwakhiwo lwesizathu, njenge-'kutheni ukubala ingeniso enye kwanele' okanye 'ngokukhupha i-B'?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.0: Amangeniso e-P^n onke ayi-p^n × 2^(n−1). Ukuba sibhala P = pB, ngoko P^n = p^n B^n, kwaye amangeniso e-B^n aphindaphindwa kabini ixesha ngalinye.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.1: Njenge-p, 2p², 4p³, ..., amangeniso aba ngamaxesha angama-2p amakhulu ixesha ngalinye siphindaphinda kanye. Amangeniso amane agcina imilo efanayo kwaye ingeniso enye yi-p×k + p×k = 2pk, ngoko amangeniso e-P^n ayi-p × (2p)^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Indlela eqala kutshintsho lokuphindaphinda kanye. Intetho ifana nempendulo yangaphambili.
